acceptanceCriteria: Fixture tests cover F1, F2, F3, F4 and F7 and each reads UNKNOWN with its closed reason code, never NONE.
NONE is emitted only when no changed path maps to any screen, every map unknown and impact omission is empty, and any exemption cites a reach_exempt glob.
The unknown-reason enum is closed and documented in the spec; an unlisted reason is a test failure.
body: Expert panel 2026-10-17 (six read-only lenses, docs/build-log/2026-10-17-cce-expert-panel.md) on CCE-V0 (docs/specs/change-compiled-e2e-v0.md) toward the owner goal: compile the E2E test that checks a change, on demand, and eventually replace hosted suites. Verified in the first slice (PR #1081): obligations.go:74 builds the catalog only at head and obligations.go:161-168 derive state only from len(Unknown) and len(Obligations); nothing reads cat.Unknowns or impact Omitted. So (F1) a changed screen that is reached but has no declared flow reads NONE, (F2) app-map unknowns are ignored, (F3) a truncated impact set reads NONE, (F4) removals are invisible because the base map is never joined, and (F7) fan-out over the limit refuses instead of reading UNKNOWN. Fix per CCE-V0-019/020: every case reads UNKNOWN with a reason from a closed set; reach_exempt globs come only from the reviewed declaration file.
title: CCE obligations: unsound NONE (flowless reached screen, ignored map unknowns, impact truncation, no base join)
